title: 第7章 玫瑰街第8章 断刃
content_zh:
第七章玫瑰街
“你听说了没？城里出现了一只怪物，昨晚已经死了好几个人！”
“听说了！这些天我们晚上都不敢出门，而且这怪物就连教会的牧师都搞不定，估计这次要从圣殿中增加人手吧！”
突然他身边的人群开始窃窃私语，似乎都在谈论一只神秘的杀人怪物，就在这时候郝宁视网膜上却弹出一条信息！
任务：任务发生变化，你必须找到韦伯利子爵的秘密，将它告诉罗德斯子爵，如果你能够将他杀死，奖励将会拥有加成。
提示：光明教会或许能够帮助你，但是光明之下也隐藏着肮脏的黑暗。
任务奖励：命运之路的抉择
“只是字面上发生了变化，但这任务一样是针对韦伯利子爵，难道这任务跟这次教会人员进入菲尼斯有关？”
郝宁回头望向教会人员离去的方向，那是通往城主的主道，估计这群人是去跟城主见面了吧，如果郝宁没记错，菲尼斯的城主是一名叫做罗德斯的子爵，罗德斯子爵是一名已经七十多岁的老头。
“不过我现在还要去玫瑰街一趟，韦伯利的事情只能迟上一点再去。”他转身往玫瑰街的方向走去。
玫瑰街是菲尼斯城内最混乱的一条街，里面什么样的人都有，可以说是活跃在阳光下的黑市，而郝宁这次就是要到那里去淘宝。
没走多远郝宁就来到了玫瑰街的入口，这条狭窄的巷子就是玫瑰街的入口，而且在巷子旁边还有两名士兵在维持着秩序，据说罗德斯的灰色收入很大一部分是来自玫瑰街。
他装作若无其事地从两名士兵面前走过，果然他们认不出换了一张脸的郝宁，刚走进巷子郝宁就感到光线瞬间暗淡了下来，四周昏暗的墙体中，仿佛若有若无地有几双眼睛在盯着他。
这条巷子也不算太长，郝宁转眼间就从巷子中走了出来，顿时仿佛来到了另外一个世界，无数的灰色房屋组成一片庞大的黑市，玫瑰街！
不过与其说这里是一条街，反而更像是一个热闹的小型镇子。
“该死！我这件东西可是从遗迹中找回来的，怎么可能才值三个铜币！”
“有四阶魔兽炎虎的幼崽！价格很公允，一个金币！”
拥挤的人流在郝宁面前不断涌动着，人群中时不时会传出一些咒骂声与争吵声。
没钱租铺位的冒险者只能在街道上摆地摊，而一些很有钱的势力则会拥有一间门面，他们来到这里都是为了同一个目的，那就是出售那些见不得光的东西。
“你说什么！你敢骗我？这张明明是普通的纸张，怎么可能是宝藏图！”一个几乎两米的壮汉一把抓住那个年轻冒险者的衣领，将他仿佛小孩子般提到空中。

“不！我没有骗你，这真的是宝藏图，不要抢走它，它是属于我的！”
高大壮汉虽然脸上非常不屑，但他的手却是将一张泛黄的羊皮纸揣进兜里，仿佛这是理所当然的事情一般。
“不！”而那名被抢的男子疯了似的抓着壮汉的手臂，想从他的手中抢回羊皮纸。
忽然一个猥琐的身影有规律地行走着，缓缓靠近着那名壮汉的身边，仿佛陌生人般擦肩而过。
但郝宁凭借着曾经身为盗贼的感知，却看到了一些不一样的事情！
刚刚那道猥琐身影将手悄悄地伸入壮汉口袋中，郝宁却没有打算多管闲事，在玫瑰街就算你杀了人也不算犯法，这里是犯人的天堂，当然前提是你要有丢掉性命的觉悟。
“不好意思！”
突然嘭的一声轻响，一个人影撞到自己身上，开始郝宁还没注意，忽然他想起刚刚撞到自己的那个人不就是那偷东西的盗贼么？
玫瑰街的盗贼非常多，而且都是惯犯，在拥挤的人群中一不留神就会被偷东西。
转眼间那个人影就钻进人群中消失不见，郝宁往口袋中一摸，身上唯一的银币消失了。
“这个小子竟然偷我唯一的银币！”此时郝宁并没有慌乱，毕竟身体的前任也是盗贼，他对于玫瑰街这里的盗贼熟得很呢！这些盗贼每次作案都会先把东西藏在一个安全的地方，然后再次寻找合适的目标。
不过现在郝宁却不着急，双眼快速地搜索着那个人的身影，在拥挤的人群中要找一个人并不简单，过了十多秒后他终于看到了那个身影，只见那个猥琐的身影跟另外一个身影走走停停，似乎在观察四周有没有人跟踪。
“原来还有同伙啊！”
郝宁对着他们两个使用了新技能侦察术，他们两人的信息瞬间出现在郝宁眼中，他们几乎说可以普通的人类，等级也只有5级，也只是两个熟手盗贼而已。
最终郝宁跟随他们走了十多分钟，远离主街道来到了一条狭窄的小路，忽然那两个身影走进了一个隐秘的转角处。他也不声不响地向着那个方向走过去，那个角落看起来非常隐秘，任凭谁看到这里都不会认为这个偏僻的角落会有人在里面。
就在这时候，郝宁突然愣住了，在他眼前十多米的地方竟然是一堵灰白色的墙壁，上面没有一丝缝隙。
但这时候郝宁却疑惑了，那两个人究竟去了哪里？他根本没有看到有人在这个转弯处走出来，郝宁回头一看，从外面街道看进去，根本看不到这堵墙的存在，更没有人会注意到墙角内这个呆呆望着墙壁的中年人。
郝宁眉头紧皱，唯一可以肯定的只能说这里有什么机关，叮！一声几乎微不可闻的声音在墙体的另一边响起！
这是一道门！郝宁连忙将耳朵附在墙上，里面果然传来一阵细小的说话声。
“这次你拿到了什么？”

“好像有一张宝藏地图和两个金币，不过还遇到了一个穷鬼，进来玫瑰街只有一个银币！”
“不会是我们的同行吧？”
“不可能，我偷他身上的东西时，那家伙根本没有发现，我们出去再收割一些猎物吧！毕竟这次并没有赚到些什么！”
郝宁可以敢肯定，他们口中的那家伙就是在说自己，听着他们若隐若现的对话，郝宁知道他们要走出来了，往后退了两步做起了热身的动作。
“那么就让我来一次黑吃黑吧！愚蠢的盗贼！”
随着郝宁话音刚落，那堵墙壁仿佛水纹般摇动起来，渐渐化为虚无，露出里面的并不宽敞的空间。
“他是！”
郝宁往地上一蹬，整个人仿佛猎豹般冲向那两个还处于惊愕状态的盗贼，他抬起右腿往其中一名盗贼肚子上踢去，身体在空中骤然一凝，拳头带着阵阵呼啸声锤向另外一个盗贼。
刹那间两声惨叫声同时响起，一名盗贼脸色就仿佛便秘般难看，捂着肚子倒在了地上，另外一名被击中脑袋的盗贼更是直接昏了过去。
而郝宁从空中稳稳地落下后，他看着一双充满力量的拳头，心中充满了兴奋的心情，估计刚刚那么一拳已经可以媲美前世那些职业拳击手的全力一击了。
“你们的藏匿地方不错嘛！”郝宁毫不客气地走到他们身边，狠狠地又给了那不安分的家伙一脚，随即他就没有理会这两个小虾米，径直走进这个没有阻碍的巷道中。
这条巷道是一条死路，大概也有一百多米长，只是被他们不知道用什么秘法给隐秘起来了。很快他的目光就被墙角上只放着一块木头与一张羊皮纸，估计那羊皮纸就是刚刚偷回来的吧。
那个没昏过去的盗贼看了看地上躺着的同伴，随即望了一眼郝宁，咬牙双手撑起自己身体就往身后逃去，他没想到自己会惹到这么一个家伙，他们偷窃的时候都很隐秘，就连黑铁阶的战士都很难发现他们的踪迹，他脑海中唯一能够想到的就是这次真的遇到行家了。
正欲夺命狂奔的盗贼忽然脚下一空，他忽然发现自己已经悬浮在半空之中。
盗贼连忙回头一看，那个可怕的“中年人”将他仿佛小孩子般提了起来。
“说吧！你们作案手法这么熟练，估计也偷到很多好东西吧！交出来，不然我会让你体验一下地狱的滋味，哼哼！”
郝宁单手提着这个猥琐的盗贼，阴深深地说道。
现在他那幻化的中年人脸庞配合现在的语气，简直就是一个杀人无数的佣兵，顿时那个盗贼脸色变得有些苍白，瞳孔开始收缩。
“不不不！不要杀我，这里真的只有这么多东西，那些东西我都交给了老大！”猥琐的盗贼伸出颤抖的手掌从口袋中掏出唯一的两个金币递给郝宁，“这是我门上身上唯一的金币了，我没有说谎！请……你不要杀掉我！”
郝宁一言不发，突然用力往他的脑袋上送上一拳，顿时这个倒霉的盗贼就像尸体一般软倒在地上。

“真是倒霉，想不到恰好碰上上交的日子。”郝宁用盗贼身上的衣服擦了擦手上的血迹，不过这次他也不是没有收获，至少还有一张宝藏图和两个金币。
“有了这两个金币，应该能够买到一些好东西了吧！”
郝宁第一时间将那张泛黄的羊皮纸拿在手中，再次对着羊皮纸使用侦察术，一行字体浮现在他的视网膜中。
神秘的宝藏图（封印状态）：可开启一个黄金级副本，副本难度为大师级。
提示：此宝藏图需要龙血开启。
龙血！那可不是容易能够得到的，至少这身体的前主人根本没有见过龙血。
他将羊皮纸收进口袋中，把目光望向另外一样东西，那是一块形似剑柄的木头，更奇怪的是在这木头使用侦察术后，他得到的竟然探查到一堆问号。
？？？（未知状态）
属性：？？？
难道是废弃物品？郝宁反复地检查了几遍，可得到的结果依然是一堆未知的问号，他心中有些无奈，将木头剑柄放回口袋中。
郝宁再次使用了梅莉的面具变换了外貌，这张中年人的脸庞上多了几道狰狞的伤疤，这样使得他看起来更老了。
“有了这两个金币应该能够从灰鼠那里买到一些好东西了吧！”他搜查过这条巷子确实没有任何东西后开始原路返回。
content_en:
Chapter 7 Rose Street
"Have you heard? A monster appeared in the city, and several people died last night!"
"I heard! We don't dare to go out at night these days, and even the church's pastor can't deal with this monster. I guess we will have to add more people from the temple this time!"
Suddenly, the crowd around him began to whisper, seeming to be talking about a mysterious murderous monster. At this moment, a message popped up on Hao Ning's retina!
Mission: The mission has changed. You must find the secret of Viscount Webley and tell it to Viscount Rhodes. If you can kill him, the reward will be increased.
Tip: The Church of Light may be able to help you, but there is also a dirty darkness hidden under the light.
Mission Reward: Choice of Destiny Road
"It's just that the words have changed, but this mission is still aimed at Viscount Webley. Is this mission related to the church personnel entering Phoenix this time?"
Hao Ning looked back at the direction in which the church personnel were leaving. That was the main road leading to the city lord. It is estimated that these people were going to meet the city lord. If Hao Ning remembered correctly, the city lord of Phoenix was a Viscount named Rhodes. Viscount Rhodes was an old man in his seventies.
"But I have to go to Rose Street now. I can only go later for Webley's matters." He turned around and walked in the direction of Rose Street.
Rose Street is the most chaotic street in Phoenix. There are all kinds of people in it. It can be said to be an active black market under the sun, and Hao Ning is going there to hunt for treasure this time.
Hao Ning came to the entrance of Rose Street after not walking far. This narrow alley was the entrance of Rose Street, and there were two soldiers maintaining order beside the alley. It was said that a large part of Rhodes' gray income came from Rose Street.
He pretended to be nonchalant and walked past the two soldiers. As expected, they didn't recognize Hao Ning with a different face. As soon as he entered the alley, Hao Ning felt that the light dimmed instantly. In the dim walls around him, there seemed to be a few pairs of eyes staring at him vaguely.
The alley was not too long. Hao Ning walked out of the alley in the blink of an eye. He suddenly seemed to have entered another world. Countless gray houses formed a huge black market, Rose Street!
But this is more like a lively small town than a street.
"Damn it! I found this thing from the ruins, how could it be worth only three copper coins!"
"There is a cub of the fourth-level magic beast Flame Tiger! The price is very fair, one gold coin!"
Crowds of people continued to surge in front of Hao Ning, and curses and quarrels could be heard from time to time in the crowd.
Adventurers who have no money to rent a shop can only set up street stalls on the street, while some wealthy forces will own a shop. They all come here for the same purpose, which is to sell those shady things.
"What are you talking about! How dare you lie to me? This is obviously an ordinary piece of paper, how could it be a treasure map!" A strong man almost two meters tall grabbed the young adventurer by the collar and lifted him into the air like a child.
"No! I didn't lie to you. This is really a treasure map. Don't take it away. It belongs to me!"
Although the tall and strong man looked very disdainful, he put a piece of yellowed parchment into his pocket as if it was a matter of course.
"No!" The man who was robbed frantically grabbed the strong man's arm, trying to snatch the parchment from his hand.
Suddenly, a wretched figure walked regularly, slowly approaching the strong man, passing by like a stranger.
But Hao Ning relied on his perception as a thief and saw something different!
The wretched figure just now put his hand quietly into the strong man's pocket, but Hao Ning had no intention of meddling in his own business. Even if you kill someone on Rose Street, it's not a crime. This is a paradise for prisoners.Tang, of course the premise is that you have the consciousness to throw away your life.
"Sorry!"
Suddenly there was a soft bang, and a figure bumped into him. Hao Ning didn't pay attention at first, but suddenly he remembered that the person who just bumped into him was the thief who stole things?
There are many thieves on Rose Street, and they are all habitual offenders. Things will be stolen if you are not careful in the crowded crowd.
In the blink of an eye, the figure disappeared into the crowd. Hao Ning touched his pocket and the only silver coin on his body disappeared.
"This boy actually stole my only silver coin!" Hao Ning was not panicked at this time. After all, his predecessor was also a thief, and he was very familiar with the thieves on Rose Street! Each time these thieves commit a crime, they first hide the items in a safe place and then look for a suitable target again.
But now Hao Ning was not in a hurry, and his eyes quickly searched for the figure. It was not easy to find someone in the crowded crowd. After more than ten seconds, he finally saw the figure. He saw the wretched figure walking around with another figure, as if he was watching to see if anyone was following him.
"It turns out there is an accomplice!"
Hao Ning used the new reconnaissance skill on the two of them. The information about the two of them instantly appeared in Hao Ning's eyes. They were almost ordinary human beings, only level 5, and they were just two experienced thieves.
In the end, Hao Ning followed them for more than ten minutes and came to a narrow path away from the main street. Suddenly the two figures walked into a secret corner. He walked in that direction quietly. That corner looked very secret. No one who saw it would think that there was anyone in this remote corner.
At this moment, Hao Ning was suddenly stunned. More than ten meters in front of him was a gray-white wall with no gaps on it.
But at this time Hao Ning was confused, where did those two people go? He didn't see anyone coming out of this corner at all. Hao Ning looked back and saw from the street outside that he couldn't see the wall at all, and no one noticed the middle-aged man in the corner staring blankly at the wall.
Hao Ning frowned. The only thing he could say for sure was that there was some kind of mechanism here. Ding! An almost inaudible sound sounded from the other side of the wall!
This is a door! Hao Ning quickly put his ear to the wall, and as expected, there was a small voice coming from inside.
"What did you get this time?"
"There seems to be a treasure map and two gold coins, but I also met a poor man who came into Rose Street with only one silver coin!"
"Can't they be our colleagues?"
"Impossible, that guy didn't even notice when I stole something from him. Let's go out and harvest some more prey! After all, we didn't earn anything this time!"
Hao Ning was sure that the guy they were talking about was talking about him. Listening to their vague conversation, Hao Ning knew that they were about to come out, so he took two steps back and started to warm up.
"Then let me have a black time! Stupid thief!"
As Hao Ning finished speaking, the wall began to shake like water ripples, gradually disappearing into nothingness, revealing the small space inside.
"He is!"
Hao Ning kicked the ground and rushed towards the two thieves who were still in a state of shock like a cheetah. He raised his right leg and kicked one of the thieves in the stomach. His body suddenly froze in the air, and his fists whizzed at the other thieves.
In an instant, two screams rang out at the same time. One thief looked as ugly as constipation and fell to the ground clutching his stomach. The other thief who was hit in the head fainted.
After Hao Ning fell steadily from the air, he looked at a pair of powerful fists, and his heart was filled with excitement. It was estimated that the punch just now was comparable to the previous one.The full blow of those professional boxers in the world.
"Your hiding place is not bad!" Hao Ning walked up to them unceremoniously and gave the restless guy another hard kick. Then he ignored the two little shrimps and walked straight into the unimpeded alleyway.
This alleyway was a dead end, probably more than a hundred meters long, but it was hidden by some secret method they didn't know. Soon his eyes were drawn to a piece of wood and a piece of parchment lying in the corner. It was probably that the parchment had just been stolen.
The thief who hadn't fainted looked at his companion lying on the ground, then glanced at Hao Ning, gritted his teeth, propped himself up with his hands, and ran away behind him. He didn't expect that he would offend such a guy. They were very secretive when they stole, and even the black iron-level warriors found it difficult to find their traces. The only thing he could think of was that he really met an expert this time.
The thief who was about to run for his life suddenly lost his feet, and he suddenly found that he was suspended in mid-air.
The thief quickly looked back and saw the scary "middle-aged man" lifting him up like a child.
"Tell me! You are so skilled in committing crimes, you must have stolen a lot of good things! Hand it over, or I will let you experience the taste of hell, hum!"
Hao Ning held the wretched thief in one hand and said deeply.
Now his transformed middle-aged face matched his current tone, and he looked like a mercenary who had killed countless people. Suddenly, the thief's face became a little pale, and his pupils began to shrink.
"No, no, no! Don't kill me. There are really only so many things here. I gave those things to the boss!" The wretched thief stretched out his trembling palms and took out the only two gold coins from his pocket and handed them to Hao Ning. "These are the only gold coins I have on my door. I'm not lying! Please... don't kill me!"
Without saying a word, Hao Ning suddenly punched his head hard, and the unlucky thief fell to the ground like a corpse.
"It's really unlucky. I didn't expect that it happened to be the day to hand it in." Hao Ning wiped the blood on his hands with the thief's clothes, but this time he was not without gains, at least there was a treasure map and two gold coins.
"With these two gold coins, I should be able to buy some good things!"
Hao Ning immediately took the yellowed parchment in his hand and used the reconnaissance technique on the parchment again. A line of font appeared in his retina.
Mysterious treasure map (sealed state): A gold-level copy can be opened, and the difficulty of the copy is master level.
Tip: This treasure map requires Dragon Blood to open.
Dragon blood! That is not easy to obtain, at least the previous owner of this body has never seen dragon blood.
He put the parchment in his pocket and looked at another object, which was a piece of wood shaped like a sword hilt. What was even more strange was that after using the reconnaissance method on the wood, he found a bunch of question marks.
? ? ? (unknown status)
Properties:? ? ?
Is it a discarded item? Hao Ning checked it several times, but the result was still a bunch of unknown question marks. He felt helpless and put the wooden sword hilt back into his pocket.
Hao Ning used Mei Li's mask again to change his appearance. This middle-aged man's face had several hideous scars, making him look older.
"With these two gold coins, I should be able to buy some good things from the squirrel!" After searching the alley and finding that there was indeed nothing, he started to return the same way.
